references.text: The parallel description of the other side of the gate opening, which also has fifteen cubits of hangings, three pillars and three sockets, forming the symmetrical counterpart to verse 14.

The fulfillment of the instructions given in Exodus 27:14–15, where Bezalel and the workers actually make the fifteen-cubit hangings on each side of the gate opening with three pillars and three sockets.
The broader context for the courtyard hangings, describing the dimensions and structure of the entire courtyard of which verse 14 is a part.
A similar construction using pillars and sockets found in the inner structure of the tabernacle, demonstrating the consistent pattern in the sanctuary's architecture.
Fulfillment of the construction command: The regulation in chapter 27 is directly carried out in chapter 38.
Complementary description: Expands the regulation to apply to both sides of the gate with identical measurements.
